integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. Standalone exact-rational, symbolic, and numerical matrix calculations are reproducibility checks; independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Exact arithmetic, finite-dimensional positive-definite equicorrelation kernel, equal blocks of size at least two.
Training centers repeated equally and full within-block sketch; no randomized partial sketch or general-kernel guarantee.
Optimality restricted to positive semidefinite rank-at-most-one denominator corrections; spectral conditioning, not runtime.
title: An optimal rank-one coarse correction for equicorrelated sketched-block preconditioning
